title: Choose the Enable layout
question: Empty Review in the Holeshot Settings world. Same copy and Enable. The Analyze capture is the aha. Pick how the shot sits on the page.

options.label: Preview then act
options.thesis: Read the promise, see Analyze, then Enable. The shot is the proof; the button is last.
options.viewport: F8 Review tab. Review plaque and Local races on this PC. Copy. A night-ink well holds the real Analyze screenshot (map beside tapes, At this spot, Results). Enable sits under the well, 128×36 orange plaque.
options.risk: The button can fall below a tall shot on a short window.

raised.raise: The shot is the destination you read, not a thumbnail.
Enable is the one pull that raises recording.

options.label: Split desk
options.thesis: Copy and Enable stay left. The shot is the right column, same split as Analyze (map beside tapes).
options.viewport: Review plaque spans the top. Left: copy then Enable. Right: Analyze screenshot filling the remaining height in a 6px night-ink well.
options.risk: A narrow F8 window squeezes the shot until the aha is unreadable.

options.label: Full well
options.thesis: The shot is the page. Copy recedes to one line. Enable sits on the dirt.
options.viewport: Review plaque. One muted line of copy. Analyze screenshot fills the pane. Enable is an orange plaque in the lower-left of the well, over the map.
options.risk: A button on the screenshot can hide the line it is meant to sell.
